deadline.value: The page gives no closing date; the department confirms or rejects acceptance about six weeks after submission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Acceptance as a doctoral candidate requires a scientific supervisor at KIT.
supervisor.quote: Acceptance as a doctoral candidate requires that you have found a scientific supervisor at KIT

funding.value: The department page does not say how doctoral researchers are funded.

entry_route.value: A degree of at least four years' standard length, or one based on an undergraduate degree, is accepted, and the degree must be above average (grade 1.5 or better, or top 35 percent).
entry_route.quote: a degree program at a university or university of teacher education with a standard period of study of at least four years or | a degree program based on an undergraduate degree program at a university

also.quote: A degree with an overall grade of "very good" (1.5) or better

notes: Application for acceptance is filed in DOCATA and the printed documents go to the Dean's Office; registration with KHYS is required first.
